_meta.description: Trailing-12-month sales volumes by member store, used by Accounts (Bob) to ground seasonal stock recommendations. Fictional demo data.

members.seasonalNote: Immune & Vitamins peak Apr-Aug (winter). Sports growing year-on-year. Weight Management runs ~6% of volume — below the co-op average for a metro store of this size, i.e. a spring growth opportunity.

springBestSellers.coopTrend: As winter immune demand eases, co-op spring sellers shift to detox/gut-health, pre-summer weight management, energy & sports (outdoor season), and clean-eating staples. Allergy/hayfever support (Vitamin C) lifts.

springBestSellers.taperLines: Ease back ordering depth on heavy winter immune lines (Elderberry lozenges, Olive Leaf) as the season turns, without dropping Vitamin D3/C which stay year-round.
